origin.headline: Built from real operational knowledge.
origin.content: ADDNEXO is the evolution of CIMA, a system developed around the operational realities of an inventory-intensive distribution business. Its foundation comes from understanding how products move, how costs accumulate, how orders are fulfilled, how customers pay and where margin can disappear.
origin.highlight: The software came from the operation. The operation did not come from the software.

realProblem.headline: Distribution is not just inventory.
realProblem.content: A distributor can have suppliers, purchase orders, inbound shipments, warehouses, customer orders, dispatches, invoices, collections and constantly changing costs.
realProblem.body: The problem is not simply knowing how many boxes are available. The problem is knowing what those boxes actually cost, where they came from, what has been committed, what has been sold, what has been collected and whether the transaction generated the margin the business expected.

distributionFlow.headline: Distribution has an economic chain, not just a sales transaction.
distributionFlow.content: A purchase affects inventory. Inventory affects orders. Orders affect dispatch. Dispatch affects invoicing. Invoices lead to liquidation. And all of those events affect margin.
distributionFlow.closing: ADDNEXO connects these events so the business can understand the operation as one system instead of a collection of isolated transactions.
distributionFlow.coreHeadline: One connected flow. One operational record.

economics.headline: The supplier invoice is not always the true cost.
economics.content: For imported and locally purchased merchandise, the economics can include transportation, customs, insurance, warehousing, handling, brokerage, logistics and other acquisition-related expenses.
economics.secondaryHeadline: ADDNEXO helps bring those costs into the operational picture.
economics.closing: Move from 'what did we pay the supplier?' to 'what did this inventory actually cost the business?'
economics.lotHeadline: From every lot to the economics of every sale.
economics.lotContent: ADDNEXO connects purchasing and inventory information with sales and financial records so management can analyze how purchased merchandise moves through the business.

items.q: Is ADDNEXO only for produce companies?
items.a: No. Produce is an important use case because the platform was developed around real inventory-intensive distribution operations, but the underlying workflows also apply to food distribution, wholesale distribution, import/export and other inventory-intensive businesses.
Yes. The ADDNEXO demonstration is free.

items.q: Can ADDNEXO help us understand the real cost of purchased inventory?
items.a: ADDNEXO is designed to capture purchase-related and associated operational costs so businesses can build a more complete landed-cost and profitability view.

items.q: Can ADDNEXO manage customers and accounts receivable?
items.a: Yes. Customer records, invoices, payment status and accounts receivable are part of the platform's operational and financial workflow.

items.q: Can ADDNEXO support import and export operations?
items.a: The platform is designed for businesses where procurement, logistics, inventory, customer orders, invoicing and collections need to remain connected. Exact requirements should be reviewed during discovery.

items.q: Can I create documents by voice?
items.a: Yes. Every module that creates records — dispatches, invoices, customers, catalog items and more — has its own voice command. Manual entry is always available so each user can choose how to work.

items.q: What can I ask the assistant?
items.a: You can ask anything about your business. Because it is grounded in your dashboards and ERP data, it answers questions like who buys the most and provides guidance based on your history: what to buy and what not to buy, who to buy from and who not to buy from, how the business is performing, monthly strategies, and advice on logistics, accounting and finance.

items.q: How does the quality report work?
items.a: Take photos of merchandise when receiving or shipping it. AI generates a summary of how it arrived or left and places the photos into a ready-made document that you can download or send directly from the app.

ADDNEXO connects to nationwide databases of produce companies and filters them by score so your list is made of relevant buyers. Contacts on that list automatically receive your company presentation on the cadence you configure, and each morning you can load your daily prices and available products to send to the entire list.

problem.h2: Your grower invoice says $42,000. What did that container of avocados actually cost you?
problem.lead: You receive a container of avocados with a $42,000 grower invoice. Your sales team prices the load off that invoice and moves it in four days. Three weeks later, the freight bill, customs entry, cold storage invoice, and repacking shrink land on accounting's desk.
problem.body: By the time your bookkeeper reconciles the month in QuickBooks and Excel, the fruit is long gone, the customer paid, and you have no idea which lots made money and which ones bled cash.
problem.marginCallout: In a business operating on 2–4% net margins, how you allocate those costs decides whether that container made money or lost money.

faq.h2: Direct answers before you book your call.

items.q: Is ADDNEXO only for fresh produce distributors?
items.a: It was engineered specifically around the hardest problems in wholesale fresh produce—lot traceability, post-invoice landed costs (freight, customs, cold storage), perishability, and shrink. If you distribute produce, meat, seafood, dairy, or imported perishables where lot margins move daily, it fits your operation out of the box.

items.q: How long does implementation actually take?
items.a: Days to a couple of weeks—not the 6 to 12 months required by NetSuite, Famous, or Prophet. We import your active products, suppliers, and customers, configure your landed cost categories, and get your team running real lots immediately.

items.q: Do I have to abandon Excel overnight?
items.a: No. We transition your operation progressively—starting with purchasing, lot receiving, and landed costing so you stop losing margin immediately, while importing your existing spreadsheets cleanly without disrupting daily dispatch.

items.q: Can it be customized to my specific operation?
items.a: Yes. Because we built the platform from the ground up with real distributors, we adapt cost allocation rules, receiving workflows, invoice formats, and operational reports to match how your warehouse and buyers actually work.

items.q: Does it calculate the true landed cost of inventory automatically?
items.a: Yes. As soon as you attach freight, customs, brokerage, cold storage, handling, or shrink to a purchase or import lot—even if bills arrive days apart—ADDNEXO automatically recalculates the exact unit cost and real gross margin of every box in that lot.

items.q: What happens during the 15-minute diagnostic call?
items.a: No slide decks and no generic software pitch. We look at how you currently track lots, allocate freight/customs/shrink, and reconcile invoices between your floor and accounting. In 15 minutes, we'll show you exactly where margin is leaking and tell you honestly if ADDNEXO fits your operation.
